title: Service Manager
summary: Post-deployment service orchestration for the core network stack. It runs automatically after a deployment and has no interactive menu, so the entries below describe the services it controls rather than menu numbers.

items.title: Passwall Engine (passwall2)
items.description: Enables the Passwall 2 service at boot and starts it after deployment.
items.usage_tip: If the Passwall panel is unreachable, enable and restart this service.

items.title: Passwall Engine (passwall)
items.description: Enables and starts the legacy Passwall 1 service when that profile was installed.
items.usage_tip: Only one engine should be active at a time.

items.title: DNS Subsystem (dnsmasq)
items.description: Reloads or restarts dnsmasq so new DNS and DHCP settings take effect.
items.usage_tip: Prefer a reload; a full restart briefly interrupts DNS for clients.

items.title: Firewall Rules (firewall)
items.description: Reloads the firewall so new zones and forwarding rules are applied.
items.usage_tip: Guest and WAN forwarding rules stay inactive until this reload succeeds.
